//devDependencies.sharp: NOT unused — do not remove, and do not move it out of the root. `packages/infra`'s DocumentsStack ConverterFunction lists sharp under CDK `bundling.nodeModules`, and NodejsFunction implements that by writing a temp package.json, copying THIS lockfile beside it, and running `npm ci` — which only resolves a package the lockfile holds at the ROOT. sharp hoisted there by luck until #762: once apps/api and apps/mobile moved to ^0.35.5, npm nested a copy under each (root `@emnapi/runtime` 1.11.0 cannot satisfy sharp 0.35.5's 1.11.3, so it would not hoist) and left no root entry. Staging Deploy then failed on `npm ci … Missing: sharp@0.35.5 from lock file` while CI stayed green, because bundling only runs at deploy time. A plain `npm install --package-lock-only` does NOT re-hoist it — only this edge does; it also lifts root `@emnapi/runtime` to 1.11.3. Same rule as the `tsx` entry below. `lib/stacks/__tests__/cdk-node-modules-root-resolvable.test.ts` now gates every `nodeModules` entry so this cannot regress silently again.
//devDependencies.tsx: NOT unused — do not remove. The root `create-admin-user` script runs `tsx` by name, the `scripts/*.ts` operational scripts are run as `npx tsx`, and apps/e2e + .github/workflows invoke `node ../../node_modules/.bin/tsx`. All of that needs tsx AT THE ROOT, and until now it only landed there by luck: four workspaces (api, e2e, infra, vpn-agent) happened to declare one range, so npm hoisted it. #762 showed that is not a guarantee — a nested vite 8.3.1 left the root tsx slot holding vite 8.3.0's *optional* peer, and npm does not install an optional peer nothing depends on, so `node_modules/.bin/tsx` was never linked and the e2e webServer died with `Cannot find module '<root>/node_modules/.bin/tsx'`. Same class as the `prisma` entry in `//overrides` below, and the same lesson: the `node ../../node_modules/.bin/<tool>` convention requires the root to OWN the tool. prisma gets that from a pin; tsx gets it from this edge. Keep this range equal to the workspaces' so all five dedupe to one hoisted copy.

//overrides.hono: @prisma/dev hard-depends on hono ^4.12.8, so as soon as apps/api moves to 4.13.x npm keeps 4.12.x hoisted at the root for prisma and nests 4.13.x under apps/api. The @hono/* companions (swagger-ui, zod-openapi, zod-validator, node-server) hoist to the root and bind their peer hono to the ROOT copy, while app.ts imports Hono from the nested one - two distinct type identities for Context/Env, so app.get('/docs', swaggerUI(...)) fails typecheck with 'MiddlewareHandler<Env> is not assignable'. Forcing one hono line collapses both copies; this is why the hono and prisma dependabot PRs (#601/#530/#545/#501) sat unmergeable for weeks. Kept as a RANGE, not a pin, so routine 4.x bumps do not re-block on this entry. //overrides.prisma: Two things in one entry, via npm's combined override form (same shape as postcss above - do NOT re-split these into two `prisma` keys, duplicate JSON keys mean the last one silently wins). `mysql2` is GHSA-3f6p-5ww8-9rcr (high, auth-plugin downgrade to mysql_clear_password leaks plaintext credentials, vulnerable <3.22.0): the prisma CLI pins mysql2 at an EXACT 3.15.3, so a plain bump cannot reach the fix and an override is the only route. It is dev-scope and unreachable in practice - this repo talks to PostgreSQL (Neon) and MSSQL, never MySQL, so prisma never loads the driver - but the fix is a clean in-range patch on the 3.x line. Force >=3.22.0 <4. Remove once prisma bumps its mysql2 pin. The version floor itself: apps/api and apps/e2e declare the SAME @prisma/client range, yet npm still installs a private copy in each workspace instead of hoisting. With nothing at the root, node_modules/.bin/prisma is never created - and that is the path the build invokes, so Typecheck/Test/E2E die with 'Cannot find module node_modules/.bin/prisma'. On the older pinned version it happened to hoist, which is why this only appeared when dependabot bumped it (#545/#501 sat unmergeable). Same hoisting quirk as babel-preset-expo and @expo/log-box above; same remedy - pin one version so it hoists. Kept as a RANGE so routine 7.x bumps do not re-block. GOTCHA: editing this alone is not enough - delete the */node_modules/prisma and */node_modules/@prisma/client keys from package-lock.json before npm install. Remove once npm hoists these on its own.
